cim: A research agenda for integrating artificial intelligence in mitigation scenario workflows
cim_eredeti: A research agenda for integrating artificial intelligence in mitigation scenario workflows
szoveg_eredeti:
Mitigation scenarios underpin climate policy. The workflow that produces them faces bottlenecks in narrative breadth, outdated inputs, model structure, computational cost and ensemble interpretation. We set out a research agenda for integrating artificial intelligence and machine learning across the workflow’s three phases. In scenario specification, language models and automated data curation can widen storylines and keep inputs current. In modelling, process-based models can be complemented by hybrid models, emulators and reinforcement learning. In policy translation, machine learning can diagnose ensembles, fill reporting gaps and downscale outputs. An agentic architecture could orchestrate these components under expert oversight. We distinguish demonstrated methods from prospective designs, set out their limitations and identify barriers in socioeconomic data, model architecture, validation and global south representation.
